ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERLOCATION_CCD
AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
AS(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM 
(
    SELECT * FROM (  
	    SELECT 
         BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,BCD.CUST_ADDR_CODE AS LocationTypeId
        ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_ADDR1, CUST_ADDR2, CUST_ADDR3, CUST_ADDR4, CUST_ADD_CITY, CUST_ADD_PROVINCE, CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE)),1) AS LocationId
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_TYPE AS ResidenceTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_PERIOD AS PeriodOfResidence
	    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
        FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
      
        UNION

	    SELECT 
         BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,BCD.CUST_ADDR_CODE AS LocationTypeId
        ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_MADDR1, CUST_MADDR2, CUST_MADDR3, CUST_MADDR4, CUST_MADD_CITY, CUST_MADD_PROVINCE, CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE)),1) AS LocationId
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_TYPE AS ResidenceTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_PERIOD AS PeriodOfResidence
	    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
	    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM    
	    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
        FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
     

    ) MONTHLY

    UNION 

    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
         BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,BCD.CUST_ADDR_CODE AS LocationTypeId
        ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_ADDR1, CUST_ADDR2, CUST_ADDR3, CUST_ADDR4, CUST_ADD_CITY, CUST_ADD_PROVINCE, CUST_ADD_ZIPCODE)),1)  AS LocationId
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_TYPE AS ResidenceTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_PERIOD AS PeriodOfResidence
        ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
        ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE
        FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
       
        UNION

        SELECT
         BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
        ,BCD.CUST_ADDR_CODE AS LocationTypeId
        ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CUST_MADDR1, CUST_MADDR2, CUST_MADDR3, CUST_MADDR4, CUST_MADD_CITY, CUST_MADD_PROVINCE, CUST_MADD_ZIPCODE)),1) AS LocationId
        ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_TYPE AS ResidenceTypeId
        ,BCD.CUST_RES_PERIOD AS PeriodOfResidence
        ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
        ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
        ,BCD.BNK_CODE
        FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
        LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
       
    ) DAILY
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,PeriodEndTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD'	AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;

---------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,13,0,':'),11,0,':'),9,0,' ') 
FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL;
 

 ------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerLocation  ( 
 CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,GlobalLocationNumber
,PreferenceId
,CustomerLocationNote
,HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason
,ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,SRC.LocationTypeId AS LocationTypeId
,SRC.LocationId AS LocationId
,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,13,0,':'),11,0,':'),9,0,' ') AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS CustomerLocationNote
,NULL AS HoldMailIndicator
,NULL AS HoldMailInitiatedById
,NULL AS HoldMailReason
,SRC.ResidenceTypeId AS ResidenceTypeId
,SRC.PeriodOfResidence AS PeriodOfResidence
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,SRC.BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO  BNKM.CustomerLocation  ( 
 CustomerId
,LocationTypeId
,LocationId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,GlobalLocationNumber
,PreferenceId
,CustomerLocationNote
,HoldMailIndicator
,HoldMailInitiatedById
,HoldMailReason
,ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence
,SourceCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 CustomerId AS CustomerId
,LocationTypeId AS LocationTypeId
,LocationId AS LocationId
,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(PeriodStartTimestamp,13,0,':'),11,0,':'),9,0,' ') AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS GlobalLocationNumber
,NULL AS PreferenceId
,NULL AS CustomerLocationNote
,NULL AS HoldMailIndicator
,NULL AS HoldMailInitiatedById
,NULL AS HoldMailReason
,ResidenceTypeId AS ResidenceTypeId
,PeriodOfResidence AS PeriodOfResidence
,'CCD' AS SOURCECODE
,BNK_CODE AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerLocation_DELTA;

END
